min_bpm.title: Slowest tempo
min_bpm.description: The slowest tempo the beats may have, in beats per minute. It must be below the fastest.

max_bpm.title: Fastest tempo
max_bpm.description: The fastest tempo the beats may have, in beats per minute. It must be above the slowest.

sensitivity.title: Onset sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How readily a rise in the onset envelope counts as an onset: higher finds softer notes.

outputs.name: beats
outputs.label: Beats
outputs.description: The beats at one steady tempo, each an instant scored 0 to 1 by the onset strength at the beat.

outputs.name: onsets
outputs.label: Onsets
outputs.description: Where notes and hits start, each an instant scored 0 to 1 by its onset strength.

outputs.name: envelope
outputs.label: Onset envelope
outputs.description: Every 512 samples at 22050 Hz: onset, the spectral flux, and rms, the loudness, each divided by its largest value in the range, so 0 to 1.
